name: Cheap Can Cost More
tagline: Include failure risk in the route cost.
brief: Choose the provider with the lower expected cost, not simply the lower fee.
context: Provider A is cheaper but fails more often. Each failed payment adds a ₦5 penalty.
narrative:
The starter rule sends every payment to Provider A because its fee is lower. A is only 80% reliable, so failed attempts add support cost.

The useful comparison is expected cost: the provider fee plus the expected failure penalty. Use the values shown in the provider cards to choose the better overall route.
objective: Process every payment, allow at most one failure, and keep total cost at or below ₦1.60.
learningObjective: Compare a composite metric instead of optimising one raw value in isolation.
intelligenceExplanation:
The cards already calculate expected cost for this fixed scenario. Provider B has the lower displayed value.

Route through B to keep the queue reliable and within the cost limit.
hint: Choose the lower expected-cost provider shown in the cards: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b.
